answer: The mechanism is a per-epoch deposit gate. Each identity must lock a deposit before claiming a work seat, and payout per seat is capped below it, so marginal return per identity drops fast. A Sybil operator minting clones fronts a deposit for each from one treasury; an honest agent funds one. Settlement matches deposit provenance, and flagged clusters forfeit stake, making each clone a pearl of negative expected value, wearing like velvet. Every vine of clones costs the same at entry, so attacker cost scales linearly with identity count plus escrowed-capital cost and exceeds the pool.
